book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.title: Book of Occult Arts
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.author: Seleris, the Chronicler of the Veil
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.02: Some rules may change from one world to another. The times, prices, and chances shown in this book are the most common, but many of these things can be changed to suit your preferences.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.03: Villagers can become Vampires, Hunters, or Werewolves. Even after transforming, they remain the same people, but their new nature changes their choices and alliances.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.04: Look for red eyes, pale skin, greater agility, and fear of sunlight. In addition, every transformed villager receives the Vampire trait.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.05: A Hunter villager usually protects other Hunters and distrusts Vampires and Werewolves. When threatened, they often use a pitchfork, and their blood contains a high concentration of garlic.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.06: Ears and claws can reveal a Werewolf. They are not very difficult to recognize once you find one. Transformed villagers receive the Werewolf trait.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.07: Vampires can drink the blood of human villagers. Villagers who are already Vampires cannot be used as a source of blood.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.08: Some bites can spread the vampire disease. Transformation takes time. Children normally cannot be bitten or infected, but they can still inherit their parents' nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.09: Be careful when trying to drink a Hunter's blood. It is harmful to Vampires and can cause negative effects.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.10: Before the transformation finishes, the disease can still be stopped. Give the infected villager a bucket of milk. If left untreated, they will become a Vampire.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.11: When the transformation ends, the villager gains some of a Vampire's powers and habits. Returning them to humanity requires the cure.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.12: During the day, Vampires seek their own bed to rest and work at night. A roof, helmet, water, or rain can still protect them. They follow orders and fight when needed.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.13: Werewolf attacks can spread lycanthropy. Transformation may take some time. Children normally cannot be bitten, but they can still inherit their parents' nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.14: Vampires, Hunters, and Werewolves do not always live together peacefully. They may refuse conversations, protect allies, or attack enemies. Guards may also defend villagers tied to the village faction.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.15: To cure a Vampire or Werewolf villager, use a long-lasting Potion of Weakness, a golden apple, and a garlic injection. The three items may be given in any order.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.16: Weakness must last at least four minutes. Give all three items within five minutes. After that, wait about three minutes for the cure to finish.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.17: Happy particles show that the cure has begun. During this period, the villager is weak and cannot fight or trade. Keep them somewhere safe and do not place them inside a block.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.18: Vampire villagers usually offer better prices to other Vampires. Humans may pay more, while Hunters and Werewolves may be refused.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.19: Hunters receive discounts when trading with Hunter villagers. Revealed Vampires and transformed Werewolves may be refused.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.20: Werewolf villagers favor other members of their own pack. Vampires and Hunters may pay more or be unable to trade. Humans are usually still accepted.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.21: A disguised Vampire may be treated as human. If their true nature is discovered during a trade, the villager may raise the price or end the trade.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.22: Factions influence trust. Gifts and conversations are still important, but enemies receive penalties and may reject flirting, kisses, or other more intimate advances.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.23: Some rivals may refuse marriage proposals. Special villagers may also refuse to follow an enemy's orders. Allies still respond to commands such as follow and stay.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.24: When only one parent is a Vampire or Werewolf, the baby has a good chance of inheriting that nature. When both parents belong to the same kind, the baby normally does as well.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.25: The child of a Vampire and a Werewolf may inherit either nature, but never both at the same time.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.26: Totems can place a village under Vampire, Hunter, or Werewolf control. Each kind of village grants benefits to members of its own faction.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.27: A Vampire village grants benefits to Vampires. A Hunter village can cure infections and gain new allies. Werewolves usually resist changes that try to remove their nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.28: When a villager is placed inside an Easy Villagers block, their faction and appearance are preserved. Enemies may be prevented from capturing them. Villagers being cured cannot be moved either.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.29: The Trader keeps each faction's prices and refusals. Use the Altar of Inspiration, Hunter Research Table, or Stone Altar to specialize Vampires, Hunters, and Werewolves.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.30: The Breeder and Incubator preserve a baby's inherited nature. MCA's villager editor can also be used normally. After editing, storing, or placing a villager, check that their nature is still correct.

book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.31: Residents of special villages sometimes need help. Ask “Could you use a hand?” while talking to them. If you accept a favor, return before time runs out. You can check on it or give up by speaking with the same person again. Helping earns 5 hearts.
